lessons.story:
UPDATED CLUB FAIR NOTICE: This version replaces the poster printed last week. The fair will still be held on Friday from one to four, but the location has moved from the courtyard to the covered hall. The change is due to repairs near the courtyard entrance.

Club leaders must send their final stall names by Tuesday noon, one day earlier than the deadline on the old poster. Table allocation remains two per club. Electrical outlets are available only along the hall's east wall and must be requested in advance.

Students may enter freely; no ticket is needed. Food stalls now close at three thirty so volunteers can clean before the hall closes at four. Non-food demonstrations may continue until three fifty, but equipment must be packed by four.

The new poster carries a revision date in its lower corner. If you see an older copy, tell the office rather than altering it by hand. Staff will replace outdated copies so visitors do not receive conflicting instructions from different walls.
lessons.title: A Notice About Notice Changes
